concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single professional game environment concept sheet explicitly based on Disney's The Weekenders Bahia Bay, using the supplied reference frames as visual references, not edit targets. Draw three separate storefront elevations, side by side, each fully visible and isolated on warm white, in the relaxed sunny hand-painted cartoon architecture of the supplied references. Left: SNACK SHACK, low lemon-yellow snack business, salmon oval sign reading SNACK SHACK in quirky red lettering, mustard roof trim, pink taller rear volume, broad teal service window, tiny slushy drink symbols. Center: FUNVILLE, compact arcade shop with lavender walls, teal corner columns, curling yellow marquee with star roundel, sign FUNVILLE, green double doors with pale lightning shapes, blue windows with coral and teal playful streaks. Right: a themed PIZZA shop using the reference's white stepped parapet, teal triangular cornice detail, sunny yellow-and-teal striped awning, golden pizza-slice sculptural roof sign and readable sign BAHIA PIZZA. These are small buildings to slot into a row of Mediterranean coastal shops, not giant standalone attractions. Give each real architectural depth in a very slight three-quarter view, no overlapping buildings, no people, no street, no beach, no palms, no surrounding scenery. Warm cream stucco, teal, pale pink, saturated yellow, weathered edges, clean readable silhouettes. Add small orthographic material notes along bottom for a low cream sandstone seawall with occasional beach-access openings, warm fine-grained sand and teal water. All three shops must be genuinely drawn from the provided Weekenders reference buildings rather than generic seaside cafés. Landscape 3:2 composition, polished concept art.
